title: Data export — README.md front lines
description: The first lines of the README.md of planastro-export-<AAAA-MM-JJ>.zip, one `key: value` each up to the first blank line, read as an object: `formatVersion` (1), the instant of the export, and the boxes present in the order of the screen (`parts: plans, places, …`). A reader that only understands version 1 refuses a later one. The rest of the README is for the person who opens it and names the line « Les images de la galerie privée restent dans l’espace : elles ne sont pas dans le fichier. »
